# OpenMediatR

> OpenMediatR is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) in-process mediator for .NET 8 and .NET 10, and an alternative to MediatR with a MediatR-compatible API. It supports requests, stream requests, notifications, pipeline behaviors, pre/post-processors, exception handlers/actions and pluggable notification sinks.

Install with `dotnet add package OpenMediatR`, register with `services.AddOpenMediatR(cfg => cfg.RegisterServicesFromAssemblyContaining<Program>())`, and use the single `OpenMediatR` namespace. To migrate from MediatR: replace the package, replace `using MediatR;` with `using OpenMediatR;`, replace `AddMediatR` with `AddOpenMediatR`, remove `LicenseKey`, and change behavior constraints from `where TRequest : notnull` to `where TRequest : IRequest<TResponse>`.

Key differences from MediatR: `IPublisher.Publish` logs handler failures instead of re-throwing them; `Send(object)` and `Publish(object)` do not exist; pipeline behaviors run in registration order (first registered is outermost).

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/getting-started): install, register, send a request
- [Migrating from MediatR](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/migrating-from-mediatr): the three changes and every behavioral difference
- [Requests](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/requests): IRequest, IRequestHandler, ISender.Send
- [Stream requests](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/stream-requests): IStreamRequest, IAsyncEnumerable, CreateStream
- [Notifications](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/notifications): INotification, INotificationHandler, IPublisher, publisher strategies
- [Pipeline behaviors](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/pipeline-behaviors): IPipelineBehavior, registration and order
- [Pre- and post-processors](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/processors): IRequestPreProcessor, IRequestPostProcessor
- [Exception handling](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/exception-handling): IRequestExceptionHandler, IRequestExceptionAction
- [Notification sinks](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/notification-sinks): INotificationSink for brokers and webhooks
- [Configuration](https://adiakys.github.io/OpenMediator/guide/configuration): every AddOpenMediatR option
